SELECT l.sku, sum(l.order_qty) q, count(*) FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON o.sales_order_id=l.sales_order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.store_id::text='928' AND o.order_date>='2024-07-01' GROUP BY l.sku ORDER BY q DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT upper(trim(l.sku)) sku, o.status, sum(l.order_qty) q FROM sales_orders o JOIN sales_order_lines l ON o.sales_order_id=l.sales_order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE trim(c.store_id::text)='928' AND o.order_date>='2024-07-01' AND upper(l.sku) LIKE '%BK%' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY q DESC
